back_story: Little Haiti is the shadow-side of Vice City: chain-link gates, painted voodoo shops, and drums that carry through the night. It's the turf of the Haitian gang — and home to Auntie Poulet, whose voodoo deals in favors deeper than money. Between Little Haiti and Little Havana, 1986 Miami fought its quiet war.
